metadata.title: Resolución 2024015321 de 2024 (INVIMA): reglamento relativo al contenido y periodicidad de los reportes de eventos adversos y los programas de Farmacovigilancia para Titulares de Registro Sanitario y Fabricantes
metadata.edition: Dated 8 April 2024 · Diario Oficial No. 52.731 of 18 April 2024 · in force 1 March 2025 (Art. 23), repealing Resolución 2004009455 de 2004 · Arts. 1-23 (Spanish)
metadata.legal_basis: INVIMA resolution under Art. 146 of Decreto 677 de 1995; the official Spanish text governs.
metadata.applicability: Applicants, sponsors and market authorization holders reporting ICSRs (see the PV Info ICSR rulebook for scope).

metadata_verification: Source-register metadata; dates and legal status require human verification.
